description.susinstantswap: Swap items between your inventory and hotbar with a long press. Short press opens the inventory as usual. Supports single-slot and full-row swapping.
config.susinstantswap.title: Su's Instant Swap — Configuration
config.susinstantswap.modEnabled.tooltip: Master switch. Turning this off disables the entire mod and restores vanilla E behaviour.
config.susinstantswap.holdThresholdMs.to: A key press held longer than this value is treated as a long press. Range: 50–1000 ms. Default: 200 ms.
config.susinstantswap.mouseReposition.to: When opening a container or the inventory, the mouse cursor automatically moves to the bottom-right corner of the screen.
config.susinstantswap.guiSwapEnabled.too: Press a key to swap items in container screens (default: Left Alt, rebindable).
config.susinstantswap.emptySlotSwapEnabl: Allow swapping with empty slots as well.
config.susinstantswap.rowSwapEnabled.too: Show green markers next to survival inventory rows. Hover over a marker and long-press the inventory key to swap the entire row with your hotbar.
config.susinstantswap.toastEnabled.toolt: Display on-screen floating notifications when a swap fails.
config.susinstantswap.debug.tooltip: Output debug messages to the game log.
config.susinstantswap.hotbarPriorityEnab: Put the swapped-out item into an empty hotbar slot first.
toast.susinstantswap.slot_locked: Target slot cannot be swapped right now
